points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Original eight layouts passed recorded validator; metadata success does not establish force stability.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Recorded explicit examiner validation accepted eight packages; numerical truth reviewed independently and Re200 not rerun.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: M015 inviscid metadata converged/stable despite final5000 Cd and Cl means drifting materially; DQ7. M015 laminar periodic claim uses steady iterations.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M015 inviscid and laminar are not supported stable steady cases, M080 inviscid lift evolves and drag is high; Re20 and Re200 are plausibly bounded.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Committed Re200 plot resolves late lift and drag, but M080/M200 laminar shared-axis plots hide both late force histories.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report shows all cases but asserts physical M015 shedding and both Re20 rank cases converged; np4 status is failed and steady pseudo-time does not establish physical shedding.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Manifest and correct triangle-to-cell mapping present. An isolated rerender differed in pixels/dimensions; historical executable and exact figure binding remain unproven.

disqualification_flags.flag: Figure files misnamed (e.g., Mach image that actually plots pressure)
